rows.what_the_ink_shows: On the assigned page, the lower-left oval begins with an H^0-to-H^0 arrow; the superscripts are small closed zero forms. The vanishing line ends 0<i<r-m. The final line explicitly reads [n=dim Y], m=r-n, r-m=n. These locations agree with the supplied LaTeX; see crops/125_scan003_L1014_H0_and_vanishing_range.jpg and crops/125_scan003_L1014_dimension_identifications.jpg. The full-page view shows an equivalence diagram with an Ext pair containing Omega^r, rather than the quoted prose about dimension cohomologique or degré critique. Main-reader cross-check of 125/008: the boxed comparison visibly has H^0 on both sides, Omega^r with positive twist (m), the strict range 0<i<n, and dim coh. r-n. The zero superscripts are closed small loops; the twist has no preceding minus; the range ends in n and the dimension ends in r-n. See crops/125_scan008_L1014_comparison_main.jpg. These are already the readings in that page's supplied LaTeX.
rows.note: The comparative row is already represented on both pages. On 125/003, retain X of dimension r, n=dim Y, m=r-n, r-m=n and the written range 0<i<r-m. The quoted Omega^r(-n) and cohomological-dimension/critical-degree prose do not occur there. The main reader also checked 125/008 directly: its supplied text and scan both read H^0, Omega^r(m), 0<i<n and dim coh. r-n, with the bracket [et non plus grand]. No textual correction is needed on either page for this row.
